packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates are batched by the merge queue like any feature PR: a Renovate PR no longer runs the heavy CI jobs on its own, so automerging it on green would merge it untested. Major bumps still need manual review.
@playwright/test must equal nixpkgs playwright-driver.version (browsers come from the nix store, see compat-playwright/package.json). Bump by hand together with the flake nixpkgs pin.

getrandom02 is pinned to 0.2 on purpose (crates/pharos-ui/Cargo.toml): the web build needs its `js` feature, which 0.3+ replaced with `wasm_js`, so a newer copy would not unify with dioxus's transitive 0.2.
workspace-hack/Cargo.toml is generated by cargo-hakari; a Renovate bump there diverges from the real graph and breaks resolution.
